rules.r1: Be suspicious of terms far below the market price
rules.r2: Always visit the site and see the item before signing
rules.r3: Check official documents such as the business registration certificate and corporate register
rules.r4: Always put the contract in writing and keep a copy
rules.r5: The larger the amount, the more important it is to have the contract and tax invoice ready first — the platform does not handle payments

how.h1: Taking a deposit first for a listing that does not exist or belongs to someone else
how.h2: Signing contracts with several people for the same item (double contract)
how.h3: Someone without authority signs, claiming to be an agent

stop.s1: Check that the name on the register or business registration matches the other party
stop.s2: Sign only after seeing the site or item
stop.s3: Put the contract in writing and keep a copy — a SogaeBank contract is only concluded when both sides sign

c2.name: Payment fraud
c2.sub: Disappearing after an advance payment, fake transfers, etc.

how.h1: Cutting off contact after receiving an advance payment
how.h2: Claiming to have paid with a fake transfer receipt or text message
how.h3: Asking you to send money to a third party's or personal account

stop.s1: Pay only into an account in the name of the other party (business) — stop if the name differs
stop.s2: Any request to pay into a SogaeBank account is fraud — SogaeBank never receives or holds payments
stop.s3: Confirm deposits directly in your banking app, not by text message

how.h1: Collecting payment or personal details through a fake delivery tracking link
how.h2: Sending a different item or a counterfeit
how.h3: Taking an upfront fee and not doing the work

stop.s1: Track parcels directly in the courier's official app or website
stop.s2: Confirm the deal only after checking the goods or service (both sides must confirm)

c4.name: Personal data/voice phishing
c4.sub: Personal data leaks, voice phishing, etc.

how.h1: Asking for verification codes or passwords
how.h2: Getting you to install a remote-control app
how.h3: Calls or texts impersonating an agency or company

stop.s1: Never share verification codes or passwords — SogaeBank never asks for them
stop.s2: Do not install unknown apps or tap unknown links
stop.s3: Keep conversations in SogaeBank chat — the record serves as evidence in a dispute

how.h1: Investment offers promising "guaranteed principal, high returns"
how.h3: False advertising that does not match reality

stop.s1: Check first with the Financial Supervisory Service that a financial product is registered
stop.s2: Loan advertising cannot be posted on SogaeBank (restricted industry)
stop.s3: Report suspicious posts or ads with "Report"

p1.d: SogaeBank never receives or holds payments. It records only the terms and the outcome.

p2.d: Business status checks and document verification raise trust.

p3.d: We support the dispute mediation process and access to records.

p4.d: Chat, contract and settlement records are kept as evidence for disputes.

r1.d: Write up what happened and submit a report.

r2.d: The team checks quickly and investigates.

r3.d: We let you know the findings and the action taken.
